messages.subject: [Mediation-information] X continous
messages.body_plain:
Hi Jaques,

  Do you mean "treatment" by "X"?  If so, yes, the reasoning is directly applicable to a continuous treatment: just think of a comparison of two different values of the treatment. 

Best,
Kosuke

Department of Politics
Princeton University
http://imai.princeton.edu
